spans.s:
यौध यौध, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. योध), warlike,
martial.
यौधाजय, अम्, n., N. of various Sāmans.

यौधिक, epithet of a particular mode of fighting
(Hari-vaṃśa 15980; also read योधिक).

यौधिष्ठिर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. युधि-ष्ठिर),
relating or belonging to Yudhi-ṣṭhira; (अस्), m. a
descendant of Yudhi-ṣṭhira; (ई), f. a female de-
scendant of Yudhi-ṣṭhira.

यौधिष्ठिरि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Yudhi-
ṣṭhira.
